name: claude-toolbox
title_zh: 装完即用的 Claude Code 生产级配置全家桶
tagline_zh: 别再从零配 MCP、skills、agents 了。这套经过实战打磨的多语言配置，装完就能跑，少踩几十个文档坑。
tagline_en: Stop wiring MCP, skills & agents from scratch. Battle-tested, multi-lang configs that just work—skip the.
desc_en: Minimal by design, explicitly multi-lang, production-ready and battle-tested collection of configs and plugins for your Claude Code agentic development workflows: mcp, configs, skills, agents and more.
why_zh: 不是散件堆砌，而是按生产环境串好的整体：配置间互相咬合，插件版本对齐，多语言开箱即用。
why_en: Not a pile of parts—it's a pre-integrated production setup. Configs interlock, plugin versions align, multi-lang ready. Saves.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Claude Code 官方 CLI 生态；不含 IDE 插件、不含非 Anthropic 模型适配。
limit_en: Only for Claude Code official CLI; no IDE plugins, no non-Anthropic model adapters. It's a starting point—your business logic is still on you.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
